question: Approve H1's triage: the rewritten DRC-4044 body (Draft A), the one-clause milestone correction (Draft B), the findings comment (Draft C), the two-PR delivery split on web/, the eleven acceptance criteria and their surface estimates — and rule on the five gate decisions, above all D4 (may the store keep the derived two-segment project label, without which AC11 is undeliverable)?

artifacts.summary: Triage found H1's approach sound and its description false in six places: three of six kept categories are not served by the snapshot (transitions, gate open/close, tool counts), tool names reach the wire only via the banned state_detail, and both panels are windowed by tab lifetime not server restart, so the old AC could pass a build that persists nothing. Store rule re-read as field provenance. Two PRs split on web/ (PR 1 full adversarial, PR 2 two lenses + arbiter); eleven ACs, AC11 interactive with a fresh-tab live drive. Five decisions with recommendations: D1 yes (version reset distinguishable), D2 not reopened, D3 yes (fix counts: five/sixth, eight POST), D4 yes (keep the project label), D5 yes (correct the on-by-default clause during promotion). Zero Linear writes.
